explanation: Walk the grid’s empty cells and backtrack over candidate digits. A candidate must be absent from its row, column and square region. Restore zero when no candidate completes the remaining board; given entries are never changed.
timeComplexity: O(q^(e+1)) safe upper-bound time for grid side q and e empty cells, including O(q) validity checks.
spaceComplexity: O(q^2) recursion-space upper bound; the board is filled in place.
